subject: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Park <hannah@swapmarket.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria

Hi Hannah —

Great to meet you at AI Infra Week last month. SwapMarket sounded like a perfect fit for a joint presence at the Exchange Summit (SF, Mar 2027) — our customers frequently ask about model routing and cost-optimizations, and I think a co-hosted demo area plus a short webinar the week before the show would amplify both brands.

High-level proposal:
- Shared 20x20 island booth (booth costs split)
- 30-minute partner webinar the week prior (recording shared)
- Joint lead handoff with 30-day SLA for qualification
- MDF ask: Redwood requests $15k to cover creative, a portion of lead gen, and a single sponsored attendee table; open to split structure

I attached a short note with baseline MDF terms so we have a starting point. Can you confirm SwapMarket priorities and whether you have a sponsorship kit we should align with? If useful, cc ops and we’ll set a 30-min ops call.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
viv@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0126
[Attachment: proposed-mdf-terms.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Park <hannah@swapmarket.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alexg@swapmarket.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — excited about this. Quick answers:
- Exchange Summit is a priority for us (good fit).
- Sponsorship kit attached; standard sponsor splits are usually 50/50 on tiered items, but we’re flexible for lead gen buys.
- For the webinar: prefer the week of Feb 21 or Feb 28 (gives us time to promote).

Couple of asks from our side:
1) Can you share expected attendee count and a sample lead scoring rubric?
2) What assets would Redwood want co-branded (email, landing page, social)?

Alex is copied to help ops/booth details — he’ll coordinate with BrightStage (our events vendor).

Best,
Hannah Park
Head of Partnerships, SwapMarket
hannah@swapmarket.com
[Attachment: swapmarket-sponsorship-kit.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Park <hannah@swapmarket.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria

Thanks Hannah — attaching a rough mutual action plan and a booth footprint. Answers inline:

- Expected uplift: we generally drive ~300 engaged leads from a 20x20 at Exchange Summit (past shows). We’ll provide a lead scoring rubric; proposed threshold = SQL if product interest + contactable in 30 days.
- Co-branded assets: landing page, two promotional emails (RSVP and reminder), and a joint social tile. Redwood covers creative for the landing page; SwapMarket handles on-brand approvals.
- MDF: Redwood proposes $15k with a 60/40 split in our favor on creative & lead-gen buys (we cover creative and half of paid social). If SwapMarket prefers 50/50 on spend, we can move to that with an additional guarantee of 50 net qualified leads.

Next steps:
- Ops call (30 min) — propose Mon Nov 22 10am PT or Tue Nov 23 11am PT.
- If we agree on MDF structure, we’ll draft an MOU and share a signed draft for legal review.

Attachments: booth-layout.png, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Partnerships
[Attachments: booth-layout.png (PNG), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:10:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria

Team — forwarding the thread from Hannah/Alex. Key negotiation points I want us aligned on before ops call:

1) MDF target: $15k ask from our side. If they push 50/50, we accept only if they guarantee 50 net qualified leads (we’ll own the lead scoring).
2) Creative ownership: Redwood produces landing page and email copy; SwapMarket retains final approval (48h turnaround).
3) Lead handoff: 3 business days for raw leads, 30 days for qualification completion.
4) Webinar timeline: webinar week ideally Feb 28; we should lock dates before Dec 10 to start promotions.

Operational asks for Vanessa/Marissa: build a one-pager that maps responsibilities and estimated spend line items (creative, paid social, floor staffing, shipping). Sergio — can you draft the revenue attribution language we use for co-sell credit?

I’ll take ops call with them if we can get one scheduled for Mon/Tue.

—Vivek

(Quoted below)

Hi Vivek & Hannah —

Nice thread. Quick confirmation from ops: BrightStage has provisional space for a 20x20 island. On MDF splits — SwapMarket is comfortable with a 50/50 split if Redwood agrees to the following:
- Commit to the webinar date (Feb 28) and provide final creative by Feb 1.
- Guarantee a minimum of 50 net qualified leads (SwapMarket will validate).
- Sign MOU / sponsorship addendum by Dec 15.

We attached our sponsorship kit and are happy to run the ops call with BrightStage in the loop. If the above looks reasonable, we’ll route an MOU draft to legal.

Alex Gomez
Events & Partnerships, SwapMarket
alexg@swapmarket.com

Date: 2026-11-30T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: RE: SwapMarket Summit co-host: booth logistics, webinar tie-in, and MDF criteria

Hannah/Alex — thanks. We’re aligned on the timeline and can accept the 50/50 MDF split provided we keep the lead quality guardrails (Redwood retains lead scoring ownership, SwapMarket validation OK). Confirming:
- Webinar date: Feb 28, 2027 (Redwood to deliver creative by Feb 1).
- MDF: $15k total, 50/50 split; Redwood will run paid social buys and share spend receipts.
- Lead guarantee: Redwood will commit to 50 net qualified leads; we’ll implement the scoring rubric in the shared mutual-action-plan.
- MOU: I’ve uploaded a draft MOU to the shared drive and attached the draft here (signed-mou-draft.pdf). Please route to legal; we’d like signatures by Dec 15.

Next steps / owners:
- Vanessa: finalize ops budget line items and confirm staffing roster by Dec 3.
- Marissa: sync on webinar promotion cadence and co-branded assets (landing page template in Drive).
- Sergio: finalize revenue attribution language for co-sell credit.
- Alex/Hannah: route MOU to your legal and confirm BrightStage will hold the provisional booth space.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this locked.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: signed-mou-draft.pdf (PDF)]
